newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Borsodchem to buy Austria's Chemol GmbH.
newsitem.headline: Borsodchem to buy Austria's Chemol GmbH.

text.p: Hungarian chemical company Borsodchem Rt will acquire the whole 100 percent stake in Vienna-registered Chemol Handels GmbH, Borsodchem announced on Friday.

Borsodchem signed a purchase agreement on September 19 with Chemo-Trade GmbH Austria and Budapest-based Chemol Rt which jointly own Chemol Handels which has 10 million Austrian schillings share capital, it said in a statement.
The purchase agreement will go into effect pending approvals of Austrian and Hungarian authorities, it said.
The company, to be renamed Borsodchem Handels GmbH, is designed to promote the distribution of Borsodchem products in Austria and in other countries neighbouring Hungary, it said.
Borsodchem said earlier that exports to these countries were especially desirable because of low logistics costs.
